authority: Paula explicit functional clarification 2026-09-30 + Recovery contracts

devHumanEntrypoint.note: The DEV entrypoint intentionally has no global project default; source resolution is project-scoped.

externalGeneral.requirement: Project configuration durably stores/resolves the questionnaire route for that project; shopper questionnaire action opens that route only when the visit flow reaches questionnaire.

externalVisit.requirement: Visit-specific questionnaire route comes from that exact visit's HR/configured mapping; no global fallback may send a shopper to another visit's questionnaire.

legacyCarryoverPolicy.requirement: An exact-identity historical approved Cinépolis certification remains satisfied until an authorized admin explicitly requests recertification.

currentFindings.title: External general questionnaire mode lacks a durable project-level route field in the current project configuration UI.
Visit-specific questionnaire route is consumed by shopper UI but is not yet proven mapped from a configurable HR column in the current live provider.
Certification bank is durable but current generation is heuristic-local, not real AI, and certification attempts/recertification are not yet durable.
Historical exact approved certification evidence is preserved but current policy does not yet satisfy the newly frozen carryover-until-recertification rule.
Document metadata is durable and viewer is full-screen, but binary Storage remains intentionally disabled in the certified DEV lane.
